intent.user_request: Synthetic demonstration: preserve a requested behavior through the design-to-code handoff.

goals.statement: An explicit request produces the specified recorded result without substituting a domain template.

non_goals: This fixture is not a game or evidence of player demand.
constraints: Local fixture only; do not publish or connect to production data.

assumptions.statement: One synthetic node is sufficient to demonstrate trace preservation.

decisions.expected_difference: New fixture, no reference parity claim.

requirements.statement: Preserve API, behaviors and logicFlow from the fixture input.

acceptance.method: Parse generated L2/L3 and compare explicit input plus trace IDs.
acceptance.expected: All explicit API/behavior/logicFlow fields and R1/D1/A1 links survive.
